name: Glass Surface

displace.description: 0 turns the edge warp off; otherwise the feDisplacementMap scale, 0-30. Needs JS; the css-only path stays a clean blur.

a11y: The panel is decorative; its content stays in normal DOM order.
The fallback tint (no backdrop-filter support, or prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) is opaque enough to keep text contrast against the worst case behind it.
The injected SVG filter defs are aria-hidden and take no layout space.
The host's own focus outline and focus-within state are untouched.
